brief: Eight crystal destruction identities led by different physical sources, attack rhythms and decays. Flame: crackle burst; nature: splinter/leaf release; storm: thunder crack and short rumble; earth: dense rubble collapse; frost: tightly clustered brittle fractures; blood: wet rupture; dark: inward fabric rush and damped collapse; light: bright plate fracture and ringing debris. Four takes each, no synthesized tones/noise.
